team.reason: No option is priced in 2.00-2.10, and ORL to win at 1.88 is the only real Winamax price on the shortlist (the model's ORL +2.0 and DEN -8.0 prices are estimates), so the desk takes the real price on the same side. Detroit are without Jalen Duren and Duncan Robinson, and Cade Cunningham is only probable with knee soreness; Orlando's Paolo Banchero is out, but he has played only two games this season.

voices.minutes: DET: Duren (hamstring), D. Robinson (quad), Prince, Okorie out; Cunningham probable (right knee soreness). ORL: Banchero out (high ankle sprain, 2 games played this season), Isaac, Penda, Nelson out. Source: NBA injury report 11/24 07:45 AM, TalkBasket.
voices.news: No lineup change found against ORL; DAL at DEN had no dated 11/24 report in the search.
voices.price: ORL ML 1.88 real; model 45.9% equals sharp market 46.0%, value 0.86. ORL +2.0 (51.3%) and DEN -8.0 (51.3%) are estimated prices only.
voices.skeptic: The switch drops the stated chance from 51.3% to 45.9% and the model shows no edge over the market on the moneyline. That is a cost, not a sourced reason against the bet, and the rules forbid an estimated price when a real one exists.
